about: Cases for plan/tools/food_model.py (R64.3). Body weight 70 kg is the reference man of Haskell 2011 (record 2i, vitamin A); PAL 2.41 is the measured value of Rwandan farmers (Harris 2025, record 2a); climate and goods available are game inputs, stated here, not record facts. Goods available are grams per person per day. The fishing village has fish beyond what anyone can eat (3 kg a day) and little grain, to test M103 (a fishing people with fish available does not starve).
